activation.note: Activation covers artifact-aspect cardinality and English plural formation, including existing names and schema-only cardinality changes. File kinds are explicitly non-exhaustive examples rather than scope restrictions. Task/file facts are directly observable; diff extraction requires a new observer and grammatical/cardinality findings are honestly labeled judgment-dependent.

audit.summary: All fourteen segments survive at the claimed destinations, with the complete naming guidance and examples available to the coder. Added rationale, inverse anti-patterns and scope framing are declared; there are no waivers or shared-node moves, and then expresses one cardinality-sensitive naming obligation.

segmentChecks.note: The then clause retains the singular-item/plural-collection rule and English pluralization requirement; given and when preserve its broad artifact-aspect scope without narrowing it to new names.
Verifier_detail explicitly defines pluralization as how to form the plural aspect, and audit repeats the definition.
Prefer[0] reproduces the regular +s rule and both examples verbatim; evidence and verifier_detail reinforce it.
Prefer[1] preserves the English irregular-form rule and all five source examples; avoid[1] adds only consistent negative examples.
Prefer[2] preserves the explicit-suffix requirement and both config and data patterns. Avoid[2] and verifier_detail clarify, without changing, which side may remain bare.
Prefer[3] preserves the primary-noun rule and both compound examples; avoid[3] is its direct and accurate inverse.

unobservable: The change fact needs a new diff/schema observer to expose new, renamed, or existing artifact aspects and item/collection shape changes, including schema-only changes.

The finding fact is explicitly llm_judged: schema cardinality, grammatical number, English plural correctness, and irregular/uncountable/compound classification are not intrinsic Datalog-observable facts.
No observable fact or grammar defines how to identify the aspect segment within an arbitrary artifact name.

review.summary: All six independently checked knowledge-rich segments are preserved with their rules and examples intact, and the coder-facing guidance is sufficient for a weak planner to make the naming decision. I agree with PASS: activation transparently declares its observer and judgment dependencies, although applicability is not deterministically decidable from Datalog-observable facts alone.
